user.title: What do you want to connect?

pv.title: Connect a PV plant
pv.description: Add the integration once per plant. The plant token is under “Show token” in the plant's Integrations tab on wabenwatt.de; the plant's name is taken over from there. A first report is sent right away, so the plant shows up as active within two minutes.

data_description.api_token: Identifies the plant; every token belongs to exactly one plant.
data_description.pv_sensors: The plant's total solar power. Plug-in solar (micro inverter): the AC value. String or hybrid inverters: the DC power of the strings — not the AC value, which for hybrid systems also contains the battery output. No total entity? Select one entity per string; the values are added up.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew plant token
reauth_confirm.description: The token of “{name}” was rejected (unknown or revoked). Enter the plant's current token from wabenwatt.de.

battery.title: Connect home storage
battery.description: Home storage is its own device with its own token. Create it on wabenwatt.de first — that is where you get the token. Saving sends a first report right away.

data_description.api_token: The home storage's token — not a plant's. You find it on wabenwatt.de on the storage's page.
data_description.battery_sensor: Your storage's power. wabenwatt expects positive = discharging.
data_description.battery_invert: Turn on if your sensor is positive while charging.
data_description.soc_sensor: The state of charge in percent. Optional — without it the storage reports only its power and cannot contribute to a hexagon balance later.

meter.title: Connect grid meter
meter.description: The meter at your grid connection is its own device with its own token. Create it on wabenwatt.de first — that is where you get the token. Give the grid power in exactly one of two forms: one signed sensor (positive = import, negative = export) or two sensors for import and export. Saving sends a first report right away.

data_description.api_token: The meter's token — not a plant's or a storage's. You find it on wabenwatt.de on the meter's page.
data_description.grid_sensor: Form 1: one sensor, positive while importing from the grid, negative while exporting — e.g. an SML reading head (16.7.0), Shelly 3EM/Pro 3EM “total_act_power”, evcc grid power. Leave empty if you use form 2.
data_description.grid_invert: Form 1 only: turn on if your sensor is positive while exporting (e.g. “grid feed-in” of some inverter integrations).
data_description.grid_import_sensor: Form 2: the import power (always ≥ 0), only together with the export sensor — e.g. Tibber Pulse “power” and “power_production”. Reported is import − export.
data_description.grid_export_sensor: Form 2: the export power (always ≥ 0), only together with the import sensor.

error.invalid_token: The token was rejected — copy it again on wabenwatt.de.
error.sensor_unavailable: {entity_id} has no numeric value right now (unavailable/unknown). Choose a sensor that currently delivers a value.
error.sensor_not_power: {entity_id} is not a power sensor (unit: {unit}). Choose a sensor in W or kW.
error.rate_limited: wabenwatt is rate limiting this plant. Wait a minute and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach wabenwatt. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.sensor_not_percent: {entity_id} is not a percentage sensor (unit: {unit}). Pick your storage's state-of-charge sensor.
error.grid_power_form: Choose exactly one form for the grid power: either one signed sensor or both the import and the export sensor.
error.token_is_pv: This token belongs to a PV system. Add it via “PV system” instead.
error.token_is_battery: This token belongs to a home storage. Add it via “Home storage” instead.
error.token_is_meter: This token belongs to a grid meter. Add it via “Grid meter” instead.
error.token_is_site: This is a site token — a site reports nothing itself. Use the token of the device (plant, home storage or grid meter) from its page on wabenwatt.de.

abort.already_configured: A plant with this token is already set up.
